mapping_policy.source: Wokann dev text label address or exact encoded Japanese source string; every JP ROM pointer word is verified.
mapping_policy.us_text: Exact EOS-terminated bytes from the translated US ROM at ELF symbol address.
mapping_policy.placeholders: Only verified Japanese-mode runtime placeholders are auto-wrapped; compact-Chinese placeholders remain in the default Chinese mode. The selected IDs are recorded above.

partner_texts.2: Japanese move names or saved/record-mixed trainer names; fixed trainer fields may contain F5 compact-Chinese data and switch mode themselves
partner_texts.3: Japanese species names, apprentice numbers, or saved/record-mixed trainer names; fixed trainer fields may contain F5 compact-Chinese data and switch mode themselves
partner_texts.4: Japanese saved/record-mixed trainer names or species names

dynamic_placeholder_audit.safety: Each runtime placeholder begins in Japanese mode and restores Chinese mode afterward. Compact-Chinese fixed fields retain their in-band F5 mode switch, so no save, link, or trainer data is rewritten.
